title: nan
authors: Nieuwenhuisen M.; Droeschel D.; Beul M.; Behnke S.
key_contribution: Presents a complete autonomous navigation system for micro aerial vehicles in complex GNSS-denied indoor environments using 3D laser scanner SLAM and multi-layered trajectory planning.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
